questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is centered (around 00:08-00:10), exactly three pens are visible in a row.
The middle pen points its writing tip downwards, while the left and right pens have their caps facing downwards. They are not all aligned identically.
All three pens appear to have dark grey/translucent barrels and black components (caps or grip/tip), sharing the same color scheme.
The middle pen shows a bare writing tip (or pencil lead) at the bottom, whereas the left and right pens have thick caps at the bottom. The middle pen is not capped like the others.
The board moves continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is uncapped and shows a writing tip, while the other two pens are capped. This violates the condition that all pens must be identical and fully capped.
